query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks
**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Launches and product**
- Databricks launched native Genie plugins on 11 November 2026 for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server. (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents)
- Databricks unveiled an updated Genie on 11 November. The agent can handle multi-step jobs that take extended time. (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-d5ce8d4f2e7d567c6d43a125_databricks-_genie_gives)
- Databricks launched agentic tools that run in the background. Genie shadows office workers and offers proactive suggestions, and a separate "Ontology" feature scans organizational data. (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html)
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, a planned governed-data offering. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions, and it is not yet generally available. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai)

**Facilities**
- Databricks moved into its new San Francisco headquarters at One Sansome, spanning 10 floors and over 200,000 sq ft. The company plans to double its headcount by 2027. (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/databricks-san-francisco-headquarters-ai-office-22525207.php)

**Deals**
- A 15 November report says Databricks' acquisition by Globex Corporation was agreed for $9.4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. The deal is expected to close next quarter. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- **Caveat:** The source does not name the company being acquired. Treat the link to Databricks as unconfirmed until verified.

**Valuation and IPO**
- As of 25 October, Databricks had no announced IPO date or public S-1. Its private valuation was reported at $190 billion, with annualized revenue above $7 billion. (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options)

**Hires**
- I found no sourced hiring or leadership changes in the window.

**Older M&A (outside the 30-day window, for context)**
- The company profile lists Panther Labs (June 2026) and Quotient AI (March 2026) as prior acquisitions. The profile is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX)

## Open questions

1. The Globex deal report (15 November) does not name the target. Is Databricks the company being acquired, and what is the confirmed status and timing of the deal?
2. How will governed access work across third-party agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot, and what is the rollout timeline for the Genie plugins and the Genie One MCP server?
3. With headcount planned to double by 2027 and no IPO date set, what are the hiring priorities for the next 12 months, and what does the company's public-listing timing look like?
